text:
Changing topology to a plain Miller two-stage with a pole-zero-cancelling Rz, and enlarging the input pair for flicker noise.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Indirect compensation leaves the output pole (gm7/CL ~24 MHz) below UGBW, so PM is 26 deg. Power forbids more gm7. Switch to Miller with Rz = (1+(CL+C1)/Cc)/gm7 so the zero cancels p2. Fix flicker noise with a larger, longer, higher-gm/Id pair and a low-gm/Id PMOS mirror. Trim currents for power margin."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (22.0, 16.0, 26.0),     # pair gm/Id (large area for flicker)
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),        # pair L
    "itail": (7e-6, 5e-6, 8e-6),     # first-stage tail current
    "i7":    (18e-6, 14e-6, 19e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmid7": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # second-stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # second-stage PMOS L
    "L3":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "ftgt":  (27e6, 25e6, 35e6),     # target UGBW used to set Cc
    "rzf":   (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),        # Rz multiplier on the pole-zero cancel value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail, i7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]
    gmidb, Lb = 15.0, 3.0

    mb = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, itail, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, i7, vds=0.9)

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=0.4, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["L3"], itail / 2, vds=1.1)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm3, gm7 = m1.gm, m3.gm, m7.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["ftgt"])
    c1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 4e-15
    rz = p["rzf"] * (1.0 / gm7) * (1.0 + (cl + c1) / cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", cc)

    # predictions
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    pmir = gm3 / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd))
    p2 = gm7 * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cl + cc * (c1 + cl)))
    fz = 1.0 / (2 * PI * cc * (rz - 1.0 / gm7))
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pmir))))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i7)
    slew = 0.8 * min(itail / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    settle = 0.6 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.6)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    mref = lut.size("n", 20.0, 1.0, 3.9e-6, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    noise_1k = 1.3 * 4.5e-7 * math.sqrt((mref.W * mref.L) / (m1.W * m1.L))
    cmrr_db = db(2 * gm1 * gm3 / (m5.gds * (m1.gds + m3.gds))) - 20.0
    psrr_db = cmrr_db - 3.0

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db}
```
